heading: Monday, October 27, 2025
topLine: ChatGPT-assisted proof settles point convergence of Nesterov's method. Also: MiniMax releases open-weight MiniMax-M2.

items.headline: ChatGPT-assisted proof settles point convergence of Nesterov's method
items.summary: Uijeong Jang and Ernest Ryu proved that the iterates of Nesterov's 1983 accelerated gradient method converge to a minimizer, a question that had been open for years. They state that ChatGPT heavily assisted in discovering the proof. The humans verified the argument, and the paper describes how the collaboration worked. The paper is an arXiv preprint.

items.headline: MiniMax releases open-weight MiniMax-M2
items.summary: MiniMax-M2 is an open-weight model for coding and agent workflows, with weights on Hugging Face and API pricing of $0.30/$1.20 per million input/output tokens. MiniMax reported a top-five overall ranking on the Artificial Analysis index at launch.
